title: FairAugment
summary: Official code for the ECML PKDD 2024 workshop paper 'Synthetic Tabular Data Generation for Class Imbalance and Fairness: A Comparative Study', comparing synthetic data generation and sampling strategies for mitigating class and group imbalance in tabular datasets. It runs SDV's TVAESynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, and CTGANSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table with SingleTableMetadata) as the core generative baselines being compared.
evidence: src/dataset.py:592-602 instantiates TVAESynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, and CTGANSynthesizer via sdv.single_table with SingleTableMetadata
